result.summary: Removes dead code, unused helper parameters, and outdated comments left over from legacy wallet support across three functional test scripts. In wallet_address_types.py, it drops an unreachable multisig loop branch and helper branches. In wallet_backup.py and wallet_hd.py, it updates docstrings describing retired RPCs and removes an ineffective -keypool=0 node parameter.
result.problem: Following the removal of legacy wallet support, several functional tests retained unreachable code, obsolete startup options, and comments describing legacy-only commands like dumpwallet and importwallet, creating technical debt and confusing developers maintaining tests.
evidence: Commit 363355a72d notes that do_multisigs = [False] made the multisig path unreachable after legacy wallet tests were removed in c847dee148, and that the path was already broken since fe838dd391.
Commit b9b33544aa notes that descriptor wallets always maintain a keypool of at least 1 and test configs already set keypool=1, making -keypool=0 an ineffective no-op.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; likely a rebase or clean commit update across the same three commits.
result.card: This PR cleans up legacy wallet leftovers across three wallet functional test scripts (wallet_address_types.py, wallet_backup.py, and wallet_hd.py). It deletes an unreachable and broken multisig test branch, removes an ineffective -keypool=0 argument, and updates comments that still described legacy dumpwallet/importwallet behavior. Test coverage is unchanged.

risk.why: Only touches Python functional tests to remove dead code and update comments without changing functional test coverage.
